{"version": "Notebook/1.0", "items": [{"type": 1, "content": {"json": "# 📊 Delivery Optimization — Overview
---
Vista d'insieme dell'utilizzo della Delivery Optimization sul parco client.
Usa il filtro **TimeRange** e **Domain** per restringere l'analisi."}, "name": "title"}, {"type": 9, "content": {"version": "KqlParameterItem/1.0", "parameters": [{"id": "timeRange", "version": "KqlParameterItem/1.0", "name": "TimeRange", "type": 4, "isRequired": true, "value": {"durationMs": 604800000}, "typeSettings": {"selectableValues": [{"durationMs": 3600000}, {"durationMs": 86400000}, {"durationMs": 604800000}, {"durationMs": 2592000000}]}}]}, "name": "parameters"}, {"type": 3, "content": {"version": "KqlItem/1.0", "query": "DOStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}

| summarize
    Devices=dcount(DeviceName),
    Jobs=count(),
    TotalGB=round(sum(TotalBytesDownloaded)/1073741824.0, 2),
    PeerGB=round(sum(BytesFromPeers)/1073741824.0, 2),
    HttpGB=round(sum(BytesFromHttp)/1073741824.0, 2),
    CacheGB=round(sum(BytesFromCacheServer)/1073741824.0, 2),
    PeerEffPct=round(100.0*sum(BytesFromPeers)/iif(sum(TotalBytesDownloaded)==0, 1, sum(TotalBytesDownloaded)), 1)", "size": 4, "title": "KPI globali", "queryType": 0, "resourceType": "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces", "visualization": "tiles", "tileSettings": {"titleContent": {"columnMatch": "Devices", "formatter": 12}, "leftContent": {"columnMatch": "TotalGB", "formatter": 12}, "showBorder": true}}, "name": "kpi"}, {"type": 3, "content": {"version": "KqlItem/1.0", "query": "DOStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}

| summarize Peers=sum(BytesFromPeers), HTTP=sum(BytesFromHttp), CacheServer=sum(BytesFromCacheServer)
| mv-expand Source=pack_array('Peers','HTTP/CDN','Connected Cache') to typeof(string),
            Bytes=pack_array(Peers,HTTP,CacheServer) to typeof(long)
| project Source, GB=round(todouble(Bytes)/1073741824.0, 3)", "size": 1, "title": "📊 Distribuzione traffico per sorgente (GB)", "queryType": 0, "resourceType": "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces", "visualization": "piechart"}, "name": "trafficDistribution"}, {"type": 3, "content": {"version": "KqlItem/1.0", "query": "DOStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}

| summarize PeerMB=sum(BytesFromPeers)/1048576.0,
            HttpMB=sum(BytesFromHttp)/1048576.0,
            CacheMB=sum(BytesFromCacheServer)/1048576.0
          by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by TimeGenerated asc", "size": 0, "title": "📈 Trend giornaliero traffico (MB)", "queryType": 0, "resourceType": "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces", "visualization": "linechart"}, "name": "dailyTrend"}, {"type": 3, "content": {"version": "KqlItem/1.0", "query": "DOStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}

| summarize TotalBytes=sum(TotalBytesDownloaded),
            PeerBytes=sum(BytesFromPeers),
            HttpBytes=sum(BytesFromHttp),
            CacheBytes=sum(BytesFromCacheServer),
            JobCount=count() by DeviceName, Domain
| extend PeerPct=round(100.0*PeerBytes/iif(TotalBytes==0, 1, TotalBytes), 1),
         TotalMB=round(TotalBytes/1048576.0, 2),
         PeerMB=round(PeerBytes/1048576.0, 2),
         HttpMB=round(HttpBytes/1048576.0, 2),
         CacheMB=round(CacheBytes/1048576.0, 2)
| project DeviceName, Domain, JobCount, TotalMB, PeerMB, HttpMB, CacheMB, PeerPct
| order by TotalMB desc
| take 50", "size": 0, "title": "🖥️ Top 50 device per traffico totale", "queryType": 0, "resourceType": "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces", "visualization": "table", "gridSettings": {"formatters": [{"columnMatch": "PeerPct", "formatter": 8, "formatOptions": {"palette": "greenRed"}}, {"columnMatch": "TotalMB", "formatter": 8, "formatOptions": {"palette": "blue"}}]}}, "name": "topDevices"}, {"type": 3, "content": {"version": "KqlItem/1.0", "query": "DOStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}

| summarize PeerBytes=sum(BytesFromPeers),
            HttpBytes=sum(BytesFromHttp),
            CacheBytes=sum(BytesFromCacheServer),
            TotalBytes=sum(TotalBytesDownloaded)
| extend BandwidthSavedGB=round((PeerBytes+CacheBytes)/1073741824.0, 2),
         BandwidthSavedPct=round(100.0*(PeerBytes+CacheBytes)/iif(TotalBytes==0,1,TotalBytes), 1)", "size": 4, "title": "💰 Banda WAN risparmiata (peer + cache)", "queryType": 0, "resourceType": "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces", "visualization": "tiles", "tileSettings": {"titleContent": {"columnMatch": "BandwidthSavedPct", "formatter": 12}, "leftContent": {"columnMatch": "BandwidthSavedGB", "formatter": 12}, "showBorder": true}}, "name": "bandwidthSaved"}], "isLocked": false}
